# Three.js r180 (0.180.0)

Vendored from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180 (MIT). Build files from build/, addons from examples/jsm/, LICENSE.txt from LICENSE. No CDN dependency at runtime. checksums.json pins shipped bytes.

V23 adds official r180 SkeletonUtils / DRACOLoader and Draco glTF decoder files from examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf. Draco license is preserved in draco/LICENSE.txt.
